# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Qualification Scorecard v1

## Scoring

Score each category from 1–5.

| Category | Weight | Score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Marine capability | 20% | 1–5 |
| Reliability | 20% | 1–5 |
| Work quality/reputation | 20% | 1–5 |
| Communication | 15% | 1–5 |
| Response availability | 10% | 1–5 |
| Compliance/insurance | 10% | 1–5 |
| Pricing transparency | 5% | 1–5 |

## Interpretation

- **4.25–5.00:** strong Preferred candidate
- **3.50–4.24:** Qualified
- **2.75–3.49:** Watch / further verification
- **Below 2.75:** not approved for normal MMC assignments

## Override rule

A high numerical score does not override a serious safety, compliance, integrity, or client-property concern.

## Review

Re-score after meaningful performance history is established and after material incidents or repeated service issues.
